title: achillea millefolium subsp. lanulosa
intro: Achillea millefolium subsp. lanulosa, commonly known as Oregon Yarrow, is a subspecies of the yarrow plant, a flowering perennial native to western North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and easing menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Oregon Yarrow include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oregon Yarrow include essential oils such as borneol, camphor, and limonene, as well as flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
